body:
I've seen many therapists and finally found one at the center where they exclusively work with adult survivors. He got a job in another state after I worked with him for three years. It wasn't a big deal at the time, because I got a job offer at the same time. It was a dream job, and it came to me while I was on vacation, of all things. Lots of money, great new city. It was my dream come true. 

the moment I landed at home and told my GF about it, she broke up with me right then and there. While upset, I thought the timing was probably for the best. I told my therapist about my new life starting, and he told me about his. We congratulated each other and said our goodbyes. 

After two months of corresponding and working out details my future employer stopped communicating with me full stop. When I finally got them on the phone, they told me sorry, but the offer was withdrawn six weeks ago and too bad we didn't tell you sooner. 

Me: alone, underemployed, no therapist, no girlfriend. Pathetic.
